Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A sales clerk and a judge each showed up early to drop their kids off at daycare today. It's easy to tell that the judge has a close relationship with their kid based on how they hugged each other goodbye, but the sales clerk just seemed to push the kid out the door, and the kid didn't seem surprised by this at all. Who is a caring parent?
A. The sales clerk
B. Can't be determined
C. The judge
